Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 /* if comm_type is null assign COMTP */

 if :control_block.comm_type is null then
 :control_block.comm_type := 'COMTP'; 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 begin

 /* Pick-up description , effective date and term date from
 valid_communication_codes */

 if :control_block.comm_type = 'COMTP' then
 select description, to_char(eff_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),
 nvl(to_char(term_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),'')
 into :control_block.description,
 :control_block.eff_date, :control_block.term_date
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type = 'COMTP'
 and comm_code = :control_block.comm_type
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate < nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 else
 select description, to_char(eff_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),
 nvl(to_char(term_date,'MM-DD-YYYY'),'')
 into :control_block.description,
 :control_block.eff_date, :control_block.term_date
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type = 'COMTP'
 and comm_code = :control_block.comm_type
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate < nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 end if;
 exception
 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18016');
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

declare

 h_status varchar2(10);
 curr_rec number;
 dup_flg1 number:=0;
 dup_flg2 number:=0;
 ins_flg number:=0;

begin

 if :vcm_block.comm_code is null then
 show_error('18045'); /* Communication code cannot be null */
 end if;

 /* Check duplicates in the database */
 
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into dup_flg1
 from valid_communication_codes
 where comm_type=:vcm_block.comm_type
 and comm_code=:vcm_block.comm_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 -- and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id
 and rownum=1;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;

 if dup_flg1=1 then
 show_error('18046');
 end if;
 
 /*Check duplicate recs which have not yet got committed */

 check_insert_rg('RG_CMCODES','C05C05',
 :vcm_block.comm_type||','||:vcm_block.comm_code||',',
 'C',dup_flg2);

 if dup_flg2=1 then
 show_error('18046'); /* Duplicate communication code */
 end if;

 /* Insert the record into Record Group */

 
 check_insert_rg('RG_CMCODES','C05C05',
 :vcm_block.comm_type||','||:vcm_block.comm_code||',',
 'U',ins_flg);

 if ins_flg =1 then
 show_error('9199'); /*Unique row insertion failed in internal record group processing*/
 end if;

end;

declare

begin
 
 /* check if eff date is null */

 if :vcm_block.eff_date is null then
 show_error('11012');
 end if;

 -- time zone change --5/13/11--sandip

 show_error('5004');
 end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** check whether user tries to delete a code type, instead of a code.
*/
declare

 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
 del_flg number :=0; 
begin
 if :vcm_block.comm_code = 'COMTP' then
 show_error('18044');
 end if;

 if :vcm_block.comm_type = 'COMTP' then
 al_id := Find_Alert('del_comm_code_Alert');
 set_alert_property(al_id, title, 'Delete Communication Type?');
 set_alert_property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you wish to delete comm type "' || 
 :vcm_block.comm_code || '" and all associated codes?' ||
 chr(10) || chr(13) || 'Delete will permenantly delete codes, and' ||
 chr(10) || chr(13) || 'Terminate will just terminate them.');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button1, label, 'Delete');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button2, label, 'Terminate');
 set_alert_button_property(al_id, alert_button3, label, 'Cancel');
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id );

 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 :vcm_block.delete_codes := 'TRUE'; -- delete
 delete_rg;
 delete_record;
 
 elsif al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 :vcm_block.delete_codes := 'FALSE'; -- terminate
 
 /* set termination date for the code_type
 and all associated codes to sysdate
 */
 :vcm_block.term_date := sysdate;
 update valid_communication_codes
 set term_date = sysdate
 where comm_type = :vcm_block.comm_code;
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 commit_form;
 initialise_windows;
 else
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 else
 delete_rg;
 delete_record;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE toolbar IS

 tbscale NUMBER := 43; -- good for 1024x768 (SVGA)
-- tbscale NUMBER := 40; -- good for 640x480 (VGA)
 item_name VARCHAR2(80);
 PROCEDURE hide_function;
 PROCEDURE set_timer;
 PROCEDURE show_function;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DELETE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DELETE_RG IS

 del_flg number:=0;
 
 chk_flg number:=0;

BEGIN

 -- check if the record exists in the record group
 
 check_insert_rg('RG_CMCODES','C05C05',
 :vcm_block.comm_type||','||:vcm_block.comm_code||',',
 'C',chk_flg);
 if chk_flg=1 then
 
 -- Delete the record from the Record Group

 check_insert_rg('RG_CMCODES','C05C05',
 :vcm_block.comm_type||','||:vcm_block.comm_code||',',
 'D',del_flg);
 if del_flg=1 then

 message('Error while deleting from the Record Group');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_block = 'VCM_BLOCK' then
 /*
 ** when list of comm types is displayed, user can
 ** click retrive button when cursor is on a particular 
 **comm type and codes for that comm type will be displayed.
 */

 begin
 if :vcm_block.comm_type = 'COMTP' then
 :global.comm_type := :vcm_block.comm_code;
 commit;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 go_block('vcm_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('control_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :control_block.comm_type := :global.comm_type;
 go_block('vcm_block');
 execute_query;
 item_change('control_block.comm_type','D');
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 if :control_block.eff_date is null then /* eff_date on control block has been made as displayed field */
 show_error('11012');
 end if;

 if form_success then
 go_block('vcm_block');
 execute_query;
 item_change('control_block.comm_type','D');
 else
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
END;
